_: The game's words in English: key - text, {0} - what is filled in, an array - the
forms of a count (one / other). Read by L.cs by absolute path past Godot's importer.
--lang en, or nothing: English is L.Default. A key missing here falls back to ru.json.
_font: the interface typeface, a file in assets/Fonts (ratel's Black Ops One,
OFL beside it). Latin only - so ru.json names none and keeps Godot's font.

squad.branch.sentry.name: Sentry

squad.branch.prop.name: Support

acttips.text_move: The tank drives within the blue zone. The first click on a hex picks it and opens the facing rose, the second drives. If no turn is left on the hex, it drives on the first click. After an attack or bonus action only an LT may move.
acttips.text_attack: A shot at a target on an axis of fire. Orange marks the hexes the gun can hit from where it stands. Hover a target off the axes to see where it can be hit from after a move. Your own tank is a target only in this mode; RMB on an enemy fires without it.
acttips.text_ambush: The gun waits on an axis: a tank that drives onto it takes a shot. Set last — it ends the unit's turn. An MT holds a sector of two adjacent axes, a casemate its hull's axis. Lifted by any order to the unit.
acttips.text_incendiary: The next shot is incendiary. A hull it fails to penetrate catches fire, as does the forest where the round stops. A penetrated one is knocked out as usual.
acttips.text_smoke_shell: The next shot is a smoke round: smoke on an empty hex of the axis that the line of fire reaches — no tank, forest, walls or mines. A mortar lobs it 3–5 hexes over everything. It is the turn's attack; the smoke lasts two rounds.
acttips.text_fire_on_move: LT fires from a hex of its path, between steps. Left-click the hex to fire from, right-click the target, left-click where to drive. Said before the move; the hexes before the shot act first: knocked out or stopped, it does not fire. No ambush on the move.
acttips.text_ram: Drive into an adjacent tank and push it one hex if your mass is enough; your own works too. With a wall ahead, a click on the hex beyond it breaks through.
acttips.text_smoke: A smoke grenade onto an adjacent hex. Smoke blocks lines of fire like forest and lasts two rounds or until a tank drives into it.
acttips.text_mine: A mine on an adjacent hex, live at once: a tank that drives onto it is knocked out.
acttips.text_pivot: Turn the hull 60° without a step — after moving, before or after the attack. Click the adjacent hex left or right of the nose.
acttips.text_overdrive: Declared before moving. This turn ambushes do not fire as the tank crosses their axes — only at a tank that stops on one. An ambush driven past is not spent. No other bonus action this turn.
acttips.text_dash: Declared before moving: no attack this turn — no shot, no ambush — but the move is half as long again (LT 8 steps, MT and TD 6, HT and HM 5). Woods and mud stop it as usual. The bonus action stays — a ram at the end of the move, say.
acttips.text_repair: Your knocked-out tank nearby is back in the fight.
acttips.text_winch: A tank {0} hexes away on an axis is pulled one hex closer — with whatever that hex does to it.
acttips.text_douse: Put out a fire on your own hull. Spends the bonus action; the shot remains.
acttips.text_endturn: Pass the turn to the other side. Whatever the unit hasn't done this turn is lost. If an order awaits confirmation — a hex picked, an ambush axis aimed — Enter confirms it first.
acttips.text_ready: Deployment done: the screen passes to the other side, and after its “To Battle” the first round begins.
acttips.text_undo: Return the unit to where it set off, with the same heading — the move can be made again. Only while nothing was done after the move and the unit is intact. Ctrl+Backspace restarts the match.
